t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice I just read indicated that the Gnomes with the longer head when it is 5 times tend to give more points. There was also a revelation about the possibility of attributing more points to the baskets when the mushroom is involved.

vb_textbox.text: To gain more points during this game, when choosing between both Gnomes, aim for the taller one when it is five times. You may want to reverse this when the Gnomes with longer heads are on the left side since more points seem to be awarded w1hen these longer Gnomes are on the right side.
